documented_option.name: --profile / profiler=true
documented_option.claim: Built-in print/accumulate component and declaration elaboration/typechecking times; separate from structured trace.profiler
documented_option.not_claimed: No guarantee of before-start current declaration output, final flush after uncaught memory exception, exact failing declaration, lower memory or absence of profiler bookkeeping

rejected_as_reliable_start_progress.trace.Elab.command: Full syntax message is constructed by withTraceNode after action; command finally converts traces to messages and snapshots report them. Not an immediate small name-only start stream.
rejected_as_reliable_start_progress.trace.Elab.definition.header/value: Name-only messages use the same completed trace mechanism; cannot promise visibility of active/fatally terminated body.
rejected_as_reliable_start_progress.trace.Elab.definition.body: Prints entire type/value; retains or formats large payloads.
rejected_as_reliable_start_progress.trace.profiler.output/serve: Explicitly retain/export structured trace data; not a no-retention logging path.

scope: Only installed exact-pin SDK source reads. No further old export scan/closure, data family, memory cap change, proof source rewrite, unsafe metadata hook or success claim.
